page.layout: Two woodcut coin medallions at the top, centred, with their legends around the rims (left: ALEXANDER; right: LEO F. CONSTANTIN). Below them one column of running text, full width, in two paragraphs. Running head at top, page number top right. Gathering signature at the foot right. No margins with text.

main_text.l: LEO F. CONSTANTIN
ALEXANDER
ALEXANDER Leonis supradicti Imperatoris frater,
eidē in imperio Constantinopolitano succesfsit, anno mun. 4866.
à Christo nato 904. Hic & Basilio patri, & Leoni fratri disimi-
lis, luxu & delitiis perditus, annum & mesem imperauit: turpis-
simum queque rebus praefecit: erumpete tandē è naribus & pu-
dendis toto die sanguine, ob crapulam ac ludum pilæ intempe-
stiuū, obiit. Vide vt supra, vbi de patre ac fratre huius memini.
CONSTANTINVS Leonis supradicti filius, septen-
nis à patre sub matris tutela relictus est, imperauit Constantino-
poli post patruum Alexandrum prædictum anno mundi 4867.
à Christo nato 905. Huic Romanus quidā Lecapenus insidias
tetendit, vtque eū omnino imperio deturbaret, nullū non lapi-
dē mouit: frustratus tamen spe sua, à propriis filiis captus, ac in
monasterium trusus est, qui antea matrē Constantini Zoen, in
monasterium truserat. Cùm autē hi Romani Lecapeni filij idē
Constantino facere tentarēt, capti ipsimet, & tonsi in monaste-
riū detrusi sunt. Constantinus itaque qui à Romano vitrico mul-
tis annis oppressus fuerat, monarchiam sic recuperat, solúsque
prudenter satis administrat, tyrannis quibusdam oppressis, Tur-
carúmq; principibus aliquot, Christianam amplectentibus pie-
tatem. Hic literas penè extinctas ab interitu vindicauit. Librum
filio Romano, qui alter est à Romano Lecapeno, reliquit: in quo
totius imperij summam, sociorum fœdera, hostium vires ra-
tiones, & consilia aperuit, quem Veneti in bibliotheca vt the-
saurum adseruant: nam & multa de Venetorum rebus disserit
liber ille. Vide vt supra. Imperauit Constantinus hic, tam solus,
quàm cum Romano Lecapeno annos 55.

page.notes: Coin legends are woodcut lettering in the medallions; the left legend reads ALEXAN / DER (around the rim), the right LEO F. / CONSTANTIN; the letters are partly worn and the line order is a reading. The signature "Iii" is followed by a mark read as "5" that may be a different sign. The "annos 55." at the end of the last line is read as printed; the second digit is uncertain. The hyphenated line breaks (disimi-lis, turpis-simum, intempe-stiuū, septen-nis, monaste-riū, mul-tis, Tur-carúmq;, ra-tiones, the-saurum) keep their printed hyphens.
